description: Update alert rule scope/status/severity/schedule/throttle, a custom rule's SQL (sqlQuery, checked like create: scoped, time-bounded, with an ip column) or instant conditions (instant: {matchMode, conditions, environments}; omitted fields such as the instant block stay as they are), or record a review action. reviewNote is kept as the version's reason. Write action; requires confirmation.

applications.description: Application keys when applicationsAll is false.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

instant.description: Custom instant rules: {matchMode, conditions: [{field, operator, value}], environments}. Fields left out keep their current values.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

reviewAction.description: Rule review action: keep_active (keep it running and stop auto-pausing it) or tuned_version (the rule was tuned; resume it).

reviewNotificationId.description: Notification id tied to this review.

severity.description: critical, high, medium or low (custom rules).

sqlQuery.description: Custom periodic rules: the replacement detection SELECT (e.g. from a securenow_alert_rule_draft with ruleId).

throttle.description: Throttle patch {enabled, minutes}: one alert per address every N minutes.

name: securenow_alert_rule_update
title: Update Alert Rule
